mentions.name: Math derivation step auditor
mentions.description: A web-based derivation step auditor that checks mathematical derivations for mistakes, whether they were written by a person or generated by an AI assistant. It reviews derivations step by step to catch errors.
mentions.problem: Mathematical derivations, whether written by a person or an AI assistant, can contain mistakes that are hard to catch without a step-by-step check.
mentions.audience: People checking mathematical derivations, including ones produced with AI assistants
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on a derivation step auditor for checking any mistakes in your (or your AI buddy's) mathematical derivations!

https://samosa-math.vercel.app/
